title: The Zombies Run From Me
summary: An immune ten-year-old turns zombies human with a high five. He saves his mom with a hug and discovers why Gary still looks tired.
frame_0: A small kid in an orange hoodie raises one hand while green neighbors run toward a barricade of cars. Its hand-painted sign reads BEWARE OF KID.
package_differences: Uses Jake’s November 22 sponsor update with the Flashloop code at top right, handle at top left and a five-second spoken phone ending photographed with this city’s cast.
